title: The Story of Jullanar of the Sea
chineseTitle: 千夜终章与山方佐德的救赎

paragraphs.en: In Persia, there once ruled a wise and pious king from Khurasan. He had many provinces and cities under his control, and all Persian kings paid homage to him. Despite his good deeds and prayers for a son, he remained childless.
paragraphs.zh: 在波斯，曾有一位来自呼罗珊的明智虔诚国王。他统治着众多省份和城市，所有波斯国王都向他朝拜。尽管他做了许多善事并祈求能有一个儿子，但他依然没有子嗣。

paragraphs.en: The king feared dying without an heir.
paragraphs.zh: 国王害怕自己在没有继承人的情况下死去。

paragraphs.en: Slave-merchants knew of the king's fondness for women and concubines. Whenever they brought slave-girls, the king would buy them at high prices, rewarding merchants with honors and exemptions from taxes. Despite these efforts, the king continued to be anxious about his lack of a son.
paragraphs.zh: 奴隶商人深知国王对美女和姬妾的喜爱。每当他们带来女奴，国王总是以高价购入，并给予商人们种种荣誉与免税的优惠作为回报。尽管如此，国王仍因没有儿子而忧心忡忡。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad spoke again:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹再次说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, I heard that despite all their efforts, the king remained depressed as he grew old without an heir to inherit the kingdom.
paragraphs.zh: 幸福的国王啊，尽管他费尽心力，国王还是因年老却未能留下继承人而郁郁寡欢。

paragraphs.en: One day, as King Shahrazad sat on his throne with his vizier and princes present, a servant entered to announce a merchant with a girl of great beauty. The king summoned the merchant, who brought in the girl, described as tall and slender, wrapped in a gold-embroidered silk cloak.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，国王沙哈拉兹德坐在王座上，与首相和王子们一同在场时，一名仆人进来宣布有一位商人带来了一位美貌非凡的少女。国王召来了那位商人，商人带来了这位少女，她身材高挑苗条，身穿一件金丝绣花披风。

paragraphs.en: The king rose from his throne and led the merchant into a private chamber. He instructed the merchant to bring the girl forward. When she was unveiled, the king was struck by her beauty; she was brighter than a banner and more delicate than a reed, with hair cascading in seven tresses like horses' tails or the night's veil.
paragraphs.zh: 国王从王座上站起，将商人引到一间私密的房间。他吩咐商人把那女孩带上前去。当女孩被揭开面纱时，国王不禁为她的美貌所震撼；她光彩照人，胜过旗帜，肌肤细腻，犹如芦苇般柔嫩，一头七束秀发如马尾般垂落，又似夜幕低垂。

paragraphs.en: The king was so captivated by her that he felt as if he had been doting on her from the moment of her unveiling. He marveled at her calm dignity and perfect proportions.
paragraphs.zh: 国王对她一见钟情，仿佛从她揭开面纱的那一刻起便对她百般宠爱。他惊叹于她的沉着与端庄，以及她完美的身材比例。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, when the monarch beheld Jullanar, he was captivated by her beauty and overwhelmed with love. Turning to the merchant, he asked, "What is the price of this girl?" The merchant replied, "I bought her for two thousand dinars from another merchant and spent three years traveling, expending one thousand more on her journey here.
paragraphs.zh: 幸福的国王啊，当君主见到朱兰娜时，他被她的美貌深深吸引，并陷入了爱河。他转向商人问道：“这个女孩要卖多少钱？”商人回答说：“我从另一个商人那里花了两千第纳尔买下她，并且在旅途中花费了三年时间，在把她带到这里的路上又额外支出了千第纳尔。”

paragraphs.en: But she is a gift to our lord." Impressed, the king rewarded the merchant with a robe of honor, ten thousand dinars, and a choice horse. The merchant bowed and left.
paragraphs.zh: 但她是一位赐予我们君主的礼物。”国王深受感动，奖赏商人大臣一件荣誉袍、一万迪纳尔金币和一匹良驹。商人鞠了一躬，然后离开了。

paragraphs.en: Then the king entrusted Jullanar to the nurses and attendants. He instructed them to prepare her and leave her alone in one of his private apartments by the sea. They followed his orders, providing her with servants, clothes, and food.
paragraphs.zh: 然后国王将朱兰娜托付给了奶妈和侍从。他吩咐她们为她做好准备，并让她独居在海边的一间私人房间中。奶妈和服务人员遵照他的指示，给她配备了仆人、衣物和食物。

paragraphs.en: When evening came, the king entered her apartment. Seeing her standing by the window, gazing at the sea, he noticed she ignored him. This led him to believe she was from a place where manners were not taught.
paragraphs.zh: 当傍晚来临，国王走进她的卧室。只见她站在窗前，凝望着大海，竟对他视而不见。这让他推测她可能来自一个礼仪不甚讲究的地方。

paragraphs.en: However, when he saw her in fine attire and adorned with jewelry, which enhanced her beauty, he reflected on God's creation.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，当他看到她穿着华丽的服饰，并佩戴着珠宝，更显得美丽动人时，他不禁想到了造物主的奇妙创造。

paragraphs.en: Approaching Jullanar, the king embraced her and sat down beside her on a couch. He kissed her, marveling at her grace and beauty. He then ordered the maids to bring food, setting it before them on golden and silver plates.
paragraphs.zh: 接近朱兰娜时，国王拥抱了她，并在一张软榻上坐下。他亲吻着她，赞叹她的优雅与美丽。随后，他下令侍女端来食物，将它们摆放在金盘和银盘前。

paragraphs.en: Almond pastries were placed in a crystal platter in the center of the table.
paragraphs.zh: 水晶盘子里摆上了杏仁酥点心。

paragraphs.en: Despite his efforts, Jullanar kept her head bowed while eating, showing no attention or interaction with him.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管他费尽心思，朱兰娜在进食时仍低着头，完全无视他的存在，也没有任何互动。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The king continued feeding Jullanar, but she remained silent, bowing her head. He asked her name, but she did not respond. After the meal, when the maids cleared away the table, the king noticed her silence and wondered if she was dumb or simply shy.
paragraphs.zh: 国王继续给朱拉纳喂食，但她依然沉默不语，低着头。他问她名字，但她没有回应。用餐过后，当侍女们收起餐桌时，国王注意到她的沉默，心想她是哑巴还是只是羞涩？

paragraphs.en: He felt sorry for her and inquired of his attendants, who confirmed that she had never spoken to anyone.
paragraphs.zh: 他同情她，便向随从询问，随从们证实她从未与任何人说过话。

paragraphs.en: He then summoned his concubines to entertain Jullanar with music and songs. However, she remained silent and sulky, which depressed the king. After dismissing them, he lay down beside her, finding her body as fair as silver.
paragraphs.zh: 他随即召来妃子，用音乐和歌曲为朱兰娜助兴。然而，她却沉默不语，神情阴郁，这让国王感到颇为沮丧。打发走她们后，他躺在她的身旁，发现她的身体洁白如银。

paragraphs.en: He took her virginity, rejoicing at this mystery of beauty and purity.
paragraphs.zh: 他夺去了她的童贞，为这份美丽与纯净的神秘而欣喜若狂。

paragraphs.en: From then on, Jullanar occupied a great place in his heart. He neglected his other women and considered her his blessing. They lived together for an entire year, but she never spoke to him.
paragraphs.zh: 从那以后，朱拉纳尔在心中占据了重要位置。他忽略了其他女人，视她为自己的幸运。他们一起生活了一整年，但她从未对他说过一句话。

paragraphs.en: This was hard for the king.
paragraphs.zh: 这对于国王来说可不容易。

paragraphs.en: One day, he turned to her again, wondering what lay behind her silence.
paragraphs.zh: 有一天，他再次转向她，好奇她为何沉默不语。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad fell silent as morning approached. Dinarzad then spoke to her sister, "Sister, what a fascinating tale!" Shahrazad replied, "This pales in comparison to the story I'll tell tomorrow if the king spares me.
paragraphs.zh: 随着晨光渐近，沙赫拉兹默不作声。迪纳兹达 then 脱口而出：“姐姐，这个故事真精彩！”沙赫拉兹回答道：“比起我明天要讲的故事来，这简直不算什么。”

paragraphs.en: It will be even more extraordinary."
paragraphs.zh: 这将更加令人惊叹。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: The king, consumed by love for Jullanar, declared one day, "O my heart's desire, my whole kingdom is not worth a grain of sand compared to your silence. I have forsaken all my other women and made you the center of my life. Pray to God to soften your heart and let me hear even one word from you."
paragraphs.zh: 国王因爱慕朱兰娜而心神不定，有一天宣布道：“哦，我心灵的渴望，我的整个王国也比不上你沉默的价值。我已经舍弃了所有其他的女人，让你成为了我生命中的中心。祈求上帝软化你的心肠，让我哪怕听到你一句话也好。”

paragraphs.en: Jullanar, after some thought, smiled and replied, "O gallant King and valiant lion, may God bless you and grant you long life. The Almighty has answered your prayers; I am bearing your child, though I do not know its gender."
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔经过一番思考后笑了笑，回答道：“英武的国王啊，勇敢的雄狮啊，愿上帝保佑你，赐你长命百岁。全能的主已经应允了你的祈求；我怀有你的骨肉，不过我不知道是男是女。”

paragraphs.en: The king's joy was immense upon hearing this. He embraced Jullanar, saying, "O my lady, O my darling, God has granted me two blessings: to hear from you and to know that you carry my child."
paragraphs.zh: 国王听后欣喜若狂，他紧紧拥抱着朱拉纳尔，脱口而出：“我的女士，我的宝贝，上天赐予我两大喜事：能听到你的声音和知道你为我孕育着孩子。”

paragraphs.en: Then the king left Jullanar and sat on his throne. Overjoyed, he ordered his vizier to distribute one hundred thousand dinars in alms to widows, orphans, and the homeless. The vizier carried out the order.
paragraphs.zh: 然后国王离开了朱兰娜，坐在了自己的王座上。他欣喜若狂，命令首相分发十万迪纳尔施舍给寡妇、孤儿和无家可归者。首相遵照指示执行了这一命令。

paragraphs.en: Returning to Jullanar, the king asked, "O my lady and heart's delight, why did you remain silent for a whole year while sharing my bed? What kept you from speaking until now?"
paragraphs.zh: 回到朱拉纳尔王宫，国王问道：“哦，我的 Lady 和心上人，你为何在与我共枕一年后仍保持沉默？是什么让你到现在才开口？”

paragraphs.en: Jullanar replied, "O King, I am an exile in a foreign land, grieving for my people. I have no father or brother."
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳回答说：“国王陛下，我是一个流落在异乡的亡国之人，为我的子民悲伤。我没有父亲和兄弟。”

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent. Dinarzad said to her sister, "What a strange and captivating story!" Shahrazad responded, "Wait until tomorrow night if I live!"
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹默不作声。丁纳兹对她说：“这个故事真是奇特而引人入胜！”沙赫拉兹adapt回答道，“如果我活到明天晚上，你就能听到更多！”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: When the king heard Jullanar's words, he replied, "If you are truly heartbroken in a foreign land, why? My entire kingdom is yours. Where are your family members and what is your name?"
paragraphs.zh: 当国王听到朱兰娜的话后，他反问道：“如果你真的在异国他乡伤心欲绝，那又是为什么呢？我的整个王国都是你的。你的家人在哪里，你叫什么名字？”

paragraphs.en: Jullanar said, "My name is Jullanar of the Sea. My father was a sea-king who died, leaving his kingdom to my mother, brother, and me. Another sea-king took our kingdom from us.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳说：“我叫朱拉纳，来自大海。我的父亲是一位海王，他去世后，将王国留给了母亲、哥哥和我。另一位海王则夺走了我们的王国。”

paragraphs.en: My mother comes from the daughters of the sea, not land. My brother's name is Sayih. One day I quarreled with him and left, swearing by God that I would throw myself into a man’s hands.
paragraphs.zh: 我的母亲出自海的女儿，并非陆地。我哥哥的名字叫赛伊赫。有一天我和他争执起来，一气之下离家出走，向天发誓要落入男人的手中。

paragraphs.en: I came to the Island of the Moon and was found by an old man who tried to make love to me but was hit on the head by me. He sold me to a pious merchant for two thousand dinars, who brought me here and sold me to you."
paragraphs.zh: 我来到了月亮岛，被一位老者发现。他企图对我图谋不轨，却被我一棒子打晕了头。随后，他以两千第纳尔把我卖给了一个虔诚的商人，这位商人带我到这里，并将我卖给了你。

paragraphs.en: If not for your kindness and love, O King, I would have thrown myself from this window into the sea and returned to my people. I was too ashamed to return with child, fearing distrust and ill-will among my people.
paragraphs.zh: 若非您仁慈且爱护我，国王陛下，我早已从这窗口跳入海中，回到我的族人之中。我怀有身孕归来实在羞愧难当，担心会给族人带来猜疑和敌意。

paragraphs.en: When the king heard Jullanar's explanation, he thanked her and kissed her between the eyes. "By God, O my lady and darling, if you leave me even for a moment, I will die," he said. He then asked how people of the sea could walk without sinking.
paragraphs.zh: 国王听了朱拉娜的解释后，向她道谢，并在她的额头上吻了一下。“天哪，我的夫人和心上人，”他脱口而出，“如果你离开我哪怕片刻，我就要死了。”随后他又问起海中的人们是如何行走而不下沉的。

paragraphs.en: She replied that they walked in water just as land dwellers walk on dry ground, due to words inscribed on Solomon's seal ring, which kept them dry.
paragraphs.zh: 她回答说，他们走在水中就像陆地居民走在干燥的土地上一样，这是因为所罗门王戒指上的铭文保护了他们不被水浸湿。

paragraphs.en: Jullanar explained that her delivery was near and requested her mother, uncle’s daughters, and brother to come so she could be with them when the child of a land king was born. She also wanted them to see her and make peace. The king's women were not skilled in assisting sea-born children, she noted.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳解释说她的预产期将近，希望母亲、叔叔的女儿们和哥哥前来，好在陆地国王的孩子出生时与她们在一起。她还希望能借此机会让她们见见自己，并求得谅解。她指出，王宫里的女人们并不擅长帮助海生婴儿。

paragraphs.en: She wished for their presence to prove that she was truly a daughter of the sea and her father was a king. When the king heard this, he responded but Shahrazad fell silent as morning approached.
paragraphs.zh: 她希望他们的到来能证明自己确是海之女，父亲也是国王。当国王听到这话后回应了什么，但沙赫拉兹在晨光渐近时却默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹又开始了她的讲述：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, when Jullanar explained her abilities to you, you agreed to whatever she wished. She told you that they walk in the sea, seeing daylight and sun, and experiencing both day and night with stars unharmed. The king was amazed by this.
paragraphs.zh: 幸福的国王，当朱兰娜向您解释她的能力时，您答应了她所有的愿望。她告诉您，她们在海中行走，能够见到日光和太阳，并且能够在星光璀璨的夜晚经历日夜更替。国王对此感到十分惊讶。

paragraphs.en: She then took out a bead of Javanese aloewood from her bosom, threw it into the fire, whistled, and spoke words unknown to you. A great cloud of smoke arose. She instructed you to hide in a closet so that she could show you her brother, mother, and cousins without them seeing you.
paragraphs.zh: 她从怀里掏出一颗爪哇沉香木珠，扔进火中，吹了声口哨，说了几句你听不懂的话。顿时烟雾腾起。她吩咐你躲到壁橱里，好让她不被他们发现的情况下向你展示她的兄弟、母亲和堂兄弟姐妹。

paragraphs.en: You hid as she commanded, watching intently. No sooner had she finished her incantation than the sea began to foam and surge. Suddenly, the water split, revealing a young man with sprouting mustaches, rosy cheeks, and teeth like gems.
paragraphs.zh: 你按照她的吩咐藏了起来，全神贯注地观察。她刚念完咒语，海面就开始泡沫翻滚，波涛汹涌。突然间，海水裂开，露出一个满脸红润、络腮胡尚未完全长齐的年轻男子，他的牙齿白如宝石。

paragraphs.en: He was more handsome than the moon and as lovely as his sister Jullanar.
paragraphs.zh: 他比月亮还要英俊，比他的妹妹朱拉纳尔还要可爱。

paragraphs.en: Following him were a gray-haired old woman and five young ladies who looked like moons, all resembling Jullanar in beauty. The king observed them closely.
paragraphs.zh: 跟随在他身后的是一个满头银发的老妇人和五位貌若明月的年轻女士，她们都与朱兰娜一样美丽。国王仔细打量着她们。

paragraphs.en: But morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 但是晨光初现，沙赫拉兹便沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹又开始了她的讲述：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, I heard that when Jullanar returned to the palace, her brother and mother greeted her joyfully. They embraced her tearfully, recounting their longing for her absence. Jullanar then recounted how she had been sold by a man who found her on the shore of the Island of the Moon to a merchant, eventually ending up with the king of this city for ten thousand dinars.
paragraphs.zh: 幸福的国王，我听说当朱拉纳尔返回王宫时，她的兄弟和母亲高兴地迎接了她。他们含泪拥抱她，诉说着对她的思念之情。接着，朱拉纳尔回忆起自己被一个在月岛岸边发现她的男人卖给商人的经历，最终以一万迪纳尔的价格来到了这座城市的国王身边。

paragraphs.en: She described a life of happiness and devotion from her new master.
paragraphs.zh: 她描述了在新主人身边幸福而虔诚的生活。

paragraphs.en: Her brother urged her to return home, but the king, upon hearing this, was overwhelmed by fear and despair, fearing Jullanar would leave him and cause his own demise due to his deep love for her and their unborn child.
paragraphs.zh: 她的哥哥催她回家，但国王听到这话后心中充满了恐惧和绝望，担心若Jullanar离开自己，他会因对她和未出生孩子的深深爱恋而自毁前程。

paragraphs.en: But Jullanar laughed at her brother's suggestion. She assured him that her current master was a pious, generous man who had treated her kindly and provided her with the best life possible.
paragraphs.zh: 但是朱兰娜对哥哥的建议一笑置之。她向他保证，目前的主人是一位虔诚而慷慨的人，对她很好，并为她提供了最好的生活。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent, ending this tale.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹阿德默然不语，就此结束了这个故事。

paragraphs.en: Jullanar told the king, "I am carrying his child. He is a king, son of another king. Though he has no son, God has blessed me with this pregnancy."
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔对国王说：“我为他怀了孩子。他是一个国王，另一位国王的儿子。虽然他没有儿子，但上帝赐予我这次怀孕。”

paragraphs.en: Her family rejoiced and assured her they would welcome her stay.
paragraphs.zh: 她的家人欢欣鼓舞，并保证会热烈欢迎她的到来。

paragraphs.en: When Jullanar requested food, servants set out a feast. The women began to eat but soon confronted the king. "You have entered our home without permission," they said angrily, "and we have eaten your food while you remain unseen."
paragraphs.zh: 当朱兰娜要求食物时，仆人们摆设了一桌盛宴。女人们开始进食，很快便对国王提出了抗议：“你未经允许闯入了我们的家，”她们生气地说，“而我们已经吃了你的食物，你却一直不见踪影。”

paragraphs.en: The king was terrified as their anger flared. Jullanar then spoke to him: "I praised you and feared for my safety. Now I see your true feelings."
paragraphs.zh: 国王见他们怒气冲天，不禁惊恐万分。接着，朱兰娜对他说：“我曾赞美过你，并为自己的安全担忧。现在我看到了你的真面目。”

paragraphs.en: The king admitted his doubts were resolved by her actions.
paragraphs.zh: 国王承认自己的疑虑已被她的行动所消除。

paragraphs.en: But Shahrazad paused, ending the story for the night.
paragraphs.zh: 但是沙海拉扎德停了下来，暂时结束了这个故事。

paragraphs.en: The next evening, Shahrazad continued: ...
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海达继续说道：...

paragraphs.en: Jullanar told the king, "How can I bear to part from you? My family felt great affection for you when I praised you to them. They said they would not leave until they met and ate with you."
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔对国王说：“我怎么舍得离开你呢？我把你的美德告诉了家人，他们对我所说的深信不疑。他们曾表示，除非亲眼见到并与你共进晚餐，否则不会离开。”

paragraphs.en: The king replied, "I hear and obey, but I was frightened by the fire I saw coming from their mouths."
paragraphs.zh: 国王回答道：“我听从您的命令，但看到他们口中喷出火焰时，我还是被吓了一跳。”

paragraphs.en: Jullanar reassured him: "Do not worry; they only show anger like this when invited without you. They are angry now because of that." She led the king to them as they sat before food, waiting for his arrival.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔安慰他说：“别担心，他们只是在你没被邀请时才会这样发怒。现在生气是因为这个。”她领着国王来到他们面前，只见他们正坐在食物前等待他的到来，显然情绪颇为激动。

paragraphs.en: When he approached, they greeted him with utmost respect and kissed the ground. They said, "O King of the age, we have one request: take care of Jullanar of the Sea, who is worthy of you just as you are worthy of her. All sea kings sought her hand in marriage, but we rejected them because we could not part from her."
paragraphs.zh: 当他走近时，他们以最高的敬意迎接他，并跪吻地面。他们说：“哦，时代的君王，我们有一个请求：请您照顾Jullanar of the Sea，她值得您就像您值得她一样。所有的海之君主都曾向她求过婚，但我们拒绝了他们，因为我们不愿与她分离。”

paragraphs.en: The king thanked them and Jullanar, then sat to converse and eat with them until they were satisfied. They washed their hands afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 国王感谢他们，并向朱兰娜表示谢意，随后便坐下与他们交谈、共进晚餐，直到大家都吃饱为止。餐后，他们还洗了洗手。

paragraphs.en: For a full month, the king lodged them in a private apartment, never leaving their company for an hour.
paragraphs.zh: 整整一个月，国王将他们安置在一间私人套房里，一刻也不曾离开他们的身边。

paragraphs.en: When Jullanar announced her delivery, the king provided all necessary medicines and potions. She gave birth to a beautiful boy, and upon seeing him, she was overjoyed. Her mother then informed the king of his new son's birth, causing him to thank God and celebrate by giving gifts and clothing the poor.
paragraphs.zh: 当朱兰娜宣布分娩时，国王准备了所有必要的药物和药剂。她生下一个英俊的男孩，看到他后，她欣喜若狂。随后，她的母亲向国王报告了这个好消息，国王为此感谢上帝，并通过施舍穷人来庆祝，给他们送去了礼物和衣物。

paragraphs.en: On the following night, Shahrazad recounted this event to the king. The king named the child Badr and ordered celebrations for ten days. He freed prisoners, distributed alms, and held a grand banquet.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹德向国王讲述了这件事。国王给这个孩子取名巴德勒，并下令庆祝十天。他释放了囚犯，施舍了钱财，并举办了一场盛大的宴会。

paragraphs.en: One day, as they sat together with Jullanar's family, her brother suddenly took the baby Badr, played with him, made him dance, then carried him out of the window into the sea. The king was shocked and distraught, but Jullanar comforted him, saying that her brother would return safely with the child.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，他们在贾卢纳的家人身边坐着时，她的哥哥突然抱起婴儿巴德，逗弄他，让他跳舞，然后抱着他从窗户跳进了海里。国王震惊且焦虑不已，但贾卢纳安慰他说，她的哥哥会安全地带着孩子回来。

paragraphs.en: Soon after, the sea began to storm. Sayih, the boy's uncle, emerged safely with the boy in his arms. He entered the room quietly, like the moon.
paragraphs.zh: 不久之后，海面上开始狂风大作。Sayih，男孩的叔叔，在风雨中安全地抱着男孩出现了。他悄无声息地走进房间，仿佛月亮一般静谧。

paragraphs.en: Turning to the king, Sayih said, "I hope you were not frightened when I dove into the sea with him." The king replied, "Yes, by God. I thought he would never return safely."
paragraphs.zh: 转头对国王Sayih说：“我希望你没有被吓得不轻，当我跟他一起跳入海中时。”国王回答道：“的确被吓到了。我还以为他永远回不来了呢。”

paragraphs.en: Sayih explained, "I took him there to pencil his eyes with a special kohl blessed by Solomon's seal ring."
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫解释说：“我把他的眼睛描画了一下，用的是一种特别的眼影，据说得到了所罗门王印玺的祝福。”

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began: "Then Sayih said..."
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开始说道：“然后赛伊赫说……”

paragraphs.en: King, Jullanar's brother Sayih approached you with a bag. He broke the seal and scattered rubies, emeralds, and other jewels before your eyes. Among them were three hundred large gemstones as big as pigeon eggs, sparkling like the sun.
paragraphs.zh: 国王朱兰娜的兄弟赛伊赫捧着一个袋子走近你，他撕开了封条，将红宝石、祖母绿和其他珠宝散落在你眼前。其中三百颗硕大的宝石，大小如同鸽子蛋，璀璨夺目，犹如阳光般耀眼。

paragraphs.en: Sayih explained that these gifts were for your son Badr and for you, since they had not known of Jullanar's whereabouts.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫解释说，这些礼物是给你的儿子巴德和你的，因为他们并不知道朱拉纳的下落。

paragraphs.en: The king was amazed by the wealth displayed. He declared one jewel worth his entire kingdom. Gratefully, he thanked Sayih and turned to Queen Jullanar, acknowledging her brother’s generosity.
paragraphs.zh: 国王对展示的财富惊叹不已，宣称一颗宝石抵得上他整个王国的价值。他感激地向赛伊赫表达了谢意，然后转向海拉娜女王，认可了她哥哥的慷慨。

paragraphs.en: The queen praised her husband and thanked Sayih.
paragraphs.zh: 女王称赞她的丈夫，并向赛伊赫表达了感谢。

paragraphs.en: Sayih then recited a poem: "Had I for Su’da's love before her wept, / I would have solace found and never had to rue, / But she wept first and made me weep and say, / 'The credit to him who is first to act is due.'"
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫 then 朗诵了一首诗：“若为苏达的爱在我之前流过泪，/ 我便能找到慰藉，无需后悔，/ 但她先哭了，让我也跟着落泪，说道，/ ‘首行者应得荣誉之誉。’”

paragraphs.en: The king thanked Jullanar's brother Sayih for his service and granted them leave to return home. After forty days, they bid farewell, weeping at the separation. They flew into the sea and disappeared, leaving the king amazed.
paragraphs.zh: 国王感谢塞伊赫为Jullanar所做的一切，并允许他们回家。四十天后，两人依依惜别，含泪相送。他们飞入海中，渐渐消失在视线之外，留下国王满心惊讶。

paragraphs.en: The king continued to treat Jullanar with great generosity. The boy grew beautiful and thrived under many attendants. His uncle, grandmother, and cousins visited frequently, but he remained a constant source of joy for the king.
paragraphs.zh: 国王继续以极大的慷慨对待朱拉纳。这个男孩在众多侍从的照料下长得英俊健康，经常让国王感到无比欢乐。他的叔叔、祖母以及堂兄弟姐妹们频繁来访，但始终是国王最常怀喜悦的心思。

paragraphs.en: By fifteen, he excelled in grammar, lexicography, penmanship, history, and the Quran, as well as archery and spearplay.
paragraphs.zh: 到十五岁的时候，他在语法、辞典编纂、书法、历史以及《古兰经》知识方面已经表现出色，并且箭术和长矛技巧也十分娴熟。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that the boy mastered all chivalric skills, including archery, spearplay, ball games, and more. He was so beautiful that people spoke of him constantly, comparing him to a poet's verse: his downy whiskers like fine drawings, and he shone like a lamp suspended from ambergris in the dark.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说那少年精通骑士的各项技艺，包括射箭、长矛技巧和球类游戏等。他英俊非凡，人们常把他比作诗人的佳句：他的茸毛般细密的胡须如同精美的画作，而他仿佛一盏悬挂在琥珀中的明灯，在黑暗中熠熠生辉。

paragraphs.en: When Badr, having learned all that befits a king, came of age, his father called the princes, lords, and chief officers to swear allegiance to him as their new king. They were delighted, loving the old king for his kindness and benevolence.
paragraphs.zh: 当巴德学识渊博，年满即位之龄时，他的父亲召集诸王子、贵族和主要官员，宣布效忠于他这位新国王。众人欢欣鼓舞，怀念旧王的仁慈与宽厚。

paragraphs.en: The next day, King Badr rode into the city with his father, princes, and troops. After entering the square, he dismounted while his father and the princes waited. He continued on, flanked by attendants and officers who announced his progress until reaching the palace entrance.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天，国王巴德与父亲、王子和士兵们骑马进城。进入广场后，他下了马，而父亲和王子们则留在马上等待。随后，他继续前行，在随从和官员的簇拥下宣布了他的到来，直到抵达宫殿大门。

paragraphs.en: There, he dismounted with assistance from his father and mother, Jullanar of the Sea.
paragraphs.zh: 在那里，在父母的帮助下，他下了马，成为了海之朱兰娜的一部分。

paragraphs.en: Badr then ascended the throne, where his father stood as a prince. He ruled justly, issuing edicts, judging disputes, and maintaining order till midday. Afterward, he visited his mother in the palace, wearing the crown like the moon.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，巴德登上王位，他的父亲作为王子站在一旁。他公正地治理国家，颁布法令，裁决争端，维持秩序直到中午。之后，他戴着王冠前往宫殿探望母亲，那王冠在他头上犹如一轮明月。

paragraphs.en: She congratulated him on his kingship, wishing them both long life and victory.
paragraphs.zh: 她向他祝贺成为国王，并衷心祝愿他们二人长命百岁、战无不胜。

paragraphs.en: Badr spent afternoons playing ball with his father and officers before returning to rule. This routine continued daily until morning overtook Shahrazad, who fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德每天下午都会和父亲以及军官们一起玩球，之后便返回王宫处理政务。这种日复一日的生活持续进行着，直到沙赫拉兹沉寂下来。

paragraphs.en: The following night, Shahrazad resumed her tale:
paragraphs.zh: 当晚，舍赫拉查德又接过了故事： --- 注：根据提供的信息，“当前段落”实际上没有具体的文本内容，因此按照要求翻译的示例是基于假设的情境进行的。如果能提供具体文字内容，可以给出更准确的翻译。

paragraphs.en: In the first year of his reign, King Badr would go to the city square every day to play ball and return to judge cases, treating all with fairness. In the second year, he began hunting and touring his realm, ensuring peace and security. He was renowned for his chivalry, valor, and justice towards his subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 在登基的第一年，国王巴德每天都会到市中心广场踢球，然后返回处理案件，对待所有人都十分公正。到了第二年，他开始狩猎并巡游全国，确保国家的和平与安全。他的英勇、骑士精神和公正治国闻名遐迩。

paragraphs.en: The old king fell ill after catching a chill at the bathhouse. As he grew worse, he summoned his son Badr to entrust him with the kingdom and his mother's care. He also called upon all princes, lords, and officers to reaffirm their loyalty to Badr.
paragraphs.zh: 老国王在温泉浴场受了凉，病情日益加重。他病重之际，将儿子巴德尔召来，托付给他王位和母亲的照顾，并要求所有王子、贵族和平民官员再次宣誓效忠巴德尔。

paragraphs.en: After lingering for a few days, the king died, and was buried with honor.
paragraphs.zh: 几日后，国王不幸离世，得以荣耀安葬。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad paused as morning approached.
paragraphs.zh: 莎赫拉兹在晨光渐近时停了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night she continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，她接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that after the old king’s death, his son King Badr mourned alongside Jullanar, her family, and all the nobles. They built him a grand tomb and observed a full month of mourning. Jullanar's brother and mother arrived to offer their condolences, praising Badr as a noble young man, fierce like a lion and radiant like the moon.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说老国王去世后，他的儿子巴德国王与朱拉纳、她的家人以及所有贵族一同哀悼。他们为他建造了一座宏伟的陵墓，并举行了整整一个月的守丧期。朱拉纳的哥哥和母亲也前来表示慰问，称赞巴德是一位高贵的年轻人，勇猛如狮子，光彩似明月。

paragraphs.en: The lords and officers then approached Badr, urging him to stop grieving over his father’s passing. They reminded him that everyone must die and that he should focus on ruling the kingdom fairly. They bathed and dressed him in fine robes adorned with jewels before crowning him and seating him on the throne.
paragraphs.zh: 众贵族和官员随后走近巴德，劝他不要为父亲的去世过于悲伤。他们提醒他，每个人最终都会死去，他应该把注意力集中在公正地治理王国上。他们给巴德沐浴更衣，并穿上镶嵌珠宝的华服，然后加冕并让他坐在王位上。

paragraphs.en: From then on, Badr ruled justly, ensuring justice for all subjects.
paragraphs.zh: 从此以后，巴德统治公正，确保了所有臣民都能得到公正对待。

paragraphs.en: For a year, Badr led a peaceful life, occasionally visited by his sea-related relatives. His reign was marked by fairness and love from his people, who blessed him for his just rule.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德尔度过了平静的一年，偶尔会受到与海洋有关的亲戚的访问。在他的统治期间，他以公正和爱心著称，人民为他的公平治理而祝福他。

paragraphs.en: Sayih visited his sister Jullanar one night. After greeting her, he sat beside her as she asked about their family. Sayih expressed concern over his son's unmarried state and suggested marrying him to a sea princess who matched in beauty and grace.
paragraphs.zh: Sayih 有一天晚上拜访了他的妹妹 Jullanar。寒暄过后，他坐在她身旁，询问起家人的近况。谈及自己的儿子尚未婚配一事，Sayih 表示担忧，并提议将儿子许配给一位海公主，这位公主不仅貌美如花，举止亦优雅大方。

paragraphs.en: Jullanar responded that she had overlooked this matter. She insisted on finding a girl equal in all virtues—beauty, piety, wisdom, nobility, and rank. Sayih named several princesses, but none pleased Jullanar.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳回答说，她确实疏忽了这一点。她坚持要找到一个在美貌、虔诚、智慧、高贵和身份上都与之相当的女子。赛伊赫列举了几位公主的名字，但没有一位让朱拉纳满意。

paragraphs.en: He then suggested checking if their son was asleep.
paragraphs.zh: 他随后建议去看看他们的儿子是否已经睡着了。

paragraphs.en: When they confirmed he was, Sayih mentioned the daughter of one king, fearing his son might be awake and fall for her. He quoted a poet: "Love starts as harmless play / But once entrenched, it takes your peace away."
paragraphs.zh: 当他们确认他醒了，赛伊赫提到了一位国王的女儿，担心他的儿子可能会醒着并被她吸引。他引用了一位诗人的诗句：“爱始于无害的游戏/一旦扎根，它会夺走你的安宁。”

paragraphs.en: When the king's sister heard his words, she replied that while he was right, she needed to know who this girl was and her father. As she knew all the sea kings and their daughters, if she deemed Jauhara worthy, she would demand her in marriage from King al-Shamandal, even at great cost.
paragraphs.zh: 当国王的妹妹听到这话，她回答说虽然他有道理，但她需要知道这个女孩是谁以及她的父亲是谁。因为她认识所有的海王及其女儿，如果她认为朱哈拉值得嫁娶，她会不惜一切代价从阿尔-沙马andal国王那里要求迎娶她。

paragraphs.en: The king then said, "I fear she might be awake; the poet says:
paragraphs.zh: 国王接着说：“我担心她可能已经醒了；诗人写道：”

paragraphs.en: [I loved her when I heard them her descry],
paragraphs.zh: [我一看到她们出现就爱上了她]

paragraphs.en: For sometimes the ear loves before the eye."
paragraphs.zh: “有时耳朵先于眼睛感知。”

paragraphs.en: He continued, "Sister, no girl is worthy of your son save Jauhara. She is his equal in beauty and grace, with rosy cheeks, a radiant brow, and jewel-like teeth. There is none sweeter or more delightful on land or sea."
paragraphs.zh: 他继续说道：“ sister，除了贾乌哈拉之外，没有哪个女孩配得上你的儿子。她与他一样美丽优雅，红润的双颊、光洁的额头和璀璨的牙齿。无论是陆地还是海洋，再也没有比她更甜美、更令人愉悦的女孩了。”

paragraphs.en: But morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 但是晨光初现，沙赫拉兹便沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began to speak again.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙哈尔扎德又开始说话了。

paragraphs.en: King Badr overheard Sayih's description of Princess Jauhara: "She has jewel-like teeth, sweet lips, black eyes, a soft body, heavy hips, and a slender waist. When she turns, she shames the deer; when she sways, she makes jealous the willow bough." Upon hearing this, Jullanar replied, "Brother, you are right.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德尔听到了赛伊赫对公主贾乌哈拉的描述：“她牙齿如宝石般璀璨，嘴唇甜美，眼睛深黑，身段柔软，臀部丰盈，腰肢纤细。她转身时令鹿颜汗颜，摇曳时让柳枝嫉妒。”听到这些话后，朱拉丁回答道：“哥哥，你说得没错。”

paragraphs.en: I have seen her many times as children, but it has been eighteen years since we last met. Indeed, by God, none but she is worthy of my son, and none but he is worthy of her."
paragraphs.zh: 我曾多次在孩童时见过她，但自从上次见面已是十八年过去了。的确，除了她，没有谁能配得上我的儿子；除了他，也没有谁能配得上她。

paragraphs.en: King Badr, though awake, pretended to sleep when his mother and uncle spoke about Princess Jauhara. His heart was on fire with love for her. Sayih then turned to Jullanar and said, "Al-Shamandal, the king of the land and sea, is powerful, proud, and ill-tempered.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管国王巴德尔已经醒来，他还是装作在睡觉，听着他母亲和叔叔谈论公主贾乌哈拉。他的心因爱而燃烧。萨伊赫随后转向朱拉丁娜说：“陆地与海洋之王阿什·沙马andal实力强大、傲慢且性情暴躁。”

paragraphs.en: Do not say anything to your son until we demand her in marriage from him. If he agrees, praise God; if not, keep quiet and seek another bride."
paragraphs.zh: 在我们向他提亲之前，不要对你儿子说任何话。如果他同意，那就谢天谢地；如果不肯，你就保持沉默，另寻佳丽。

paragraphs.en: Jullanar agreed, deeming it a good plan. The king spent the night with his heart consumed by love for Princess Jauhara but concealed his feelings, saying nothing to his mother and uncle.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳同意了这个计划，认为这是一条好计策。国王整晚心猿意马地思念着公主贾乌哈拉，但隐瞒了自己的情感，对母亲和叔叔只字未提。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, King Badr and his uncle went to bathe. Afterward, they ate and drank with their mother until satisfied. Sayih then asked the king and his sister for permission to return home, as he had been away for many days and his mother was worried.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，巴德国王和他的叔叔去沐浴。洗漱完毕后，他们与母亲一同用餐、饮酒，直到吃饱喝足。随后，赛伊赫向国王和姐姐请求允许他返回家中，因为他已经在外多日，母亲非常牵挂。

paragraphs.en: Badr bade farewell to his uncle and rode alone into a meadow by a stream. He intended to rest but thought of Princess Jullanar’s beauty and grace, weeping bitterly.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德向叔叔告别，独自骑马来到一条溪流旁的草地上。他本打算休息一下，但想到海公主朱拉纳尔的美貌与优雅，不禁泪如雨下。

paragraphs.en: Unbeknownst to Badr, his uncle followed him. When the king dismounted at the stream's edge, his uncle hid nearby. From there, he heard Badr recite these verses:
paragraphs.zh: 不知Badr的叔叔悄悄跟在他身后。当国王在溪边下马时，他的叔叔藏在附近。从那里，他听到Badr吟诵着这些诗句：

paragraphs.en: Who will help me with a hard, full-hipped girl, Whose face is bright like the sun, nay brighter. My heart is her captive and willing slave, Lost in love for al-Shamandal’s daughter. I will never forget her all my life; I will never love anyone but her.
paragraphs.zh: 谁能帮我应对这样一个丰满、面庞如阳光般明媚的女孩呢？她的容颜甚至比太阳还要灿烂。我的心已成了她情愿的俘虏，沉溺于对阿什曼达勒女儿的爱中。我此生都不会忘记她；除了她，我再也不会爱上任何人。

paragraphs.en: Sayih heard Badr's verses and exclaimed, "There is no power and no strength, save in God, the Almighty, the Magnificent." He then revealed his conversation with Badr's mother about Jauhara. Badr admitted he was smitten with her and could not let her go.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫听罢巴德的诗篇，脱口而出：“除真主——至强至荣者外，别无依凭。”随后他讲述了自己与巴德母亲关于贾乌哈拉的谈话。巴德承认自己对她一见钟情，无法放手。

paragraphs.en: Sayih proposed returning to their mother to inform her of his plan to take Badr and demand Jauhara in marriage. He feared reproach if he went without her consent, as it would separate them and leave the city without a king. Sayih's words moved Badr, who refused to return home for advice.
paragraphs.zh: Sayih提议返回母亲那里，告知她自己的计划：带BADR回去，并要求JAUHARA嫁给他。他担心未经同意就行动会招致责备，这不仅会使他们分离，还会让这座城市失去一位国王。Sayih的话触动了Badr，Badr拒绝回家征求意见。

paragraphs.en: Badr decided to go with Sayih now and inform his mother later. Upon hearing this, Sayih was uncertain but prayed for divine assistance.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德决定现在和赛伊赫一起出发，回来后再告诉母亲。听到这话，赛伊赫有些犹豫，但仍祈求上天的帮助。

paragraphs.en: Morning came before they could continue their discussion. Shahrazad paused her story, signaling the end of that night's narrative.
paragraphs.zh: 天刚蒙蒙亮，他们还没来得及继续讨论。沙赫拉兹阿德暂停了故事，暗示今晚的叙述到此为止。

paragraphs.en: King Badr's uncle gave him a seal ring engraved with God’s name to protect him from sea beasts. They journeyed until they reached the uncle's palace, where King Badr greeted his grandmother and was warmly received.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德的叔叔送给他一枚刻有上帝名字的图章戒指，以保护他免受海兽侵害。他们一路前行，直到抵达叔叔的宫殿，在那里国王巴德见到了他的祖母，并受到了热烈欢迎。

paragraphs.en: Sayih informed their mother that Badr had fallen for Jauhara, al-Shamandal’s daughter, upon hearing of her. Sayih said he brought this news to demand Jauhara in marriage on Badr’s behalf. Upon learning this, the grandmother was upset, fearing al-Shamandal's rejection and potential embarrassment.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫告诉母亲，巴德听说贾乌哈拉——沙马纳尔的女儿后，对她一见钟情。赛伊赫说他带来这个消息是为了替巴德向贾乌哈拉求婚。听到这番话，祖母显得很不安，担心沙马纳尔的拒绝可能会给自己带来尴尬。

paragraphs.en: Sayih asked what to do, as Badr was determined to marry Jauhara, even if it meant giving up his kingdom. However, morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫询问该怎么办，因为巴德决心迎娶贾乌哈拉，即使这意味着放弃他的王位。然而，黎明来临，沙赫札德默不作声了。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙哈尔扎德又开始了她的讲述。

paragraphs.en: Sayih told his mother, "My nephew is superior to Jauhara. His father was the king of all Persians, and now he rules them. Only she is worthy of him, and only he of her.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫对母亲说：“我的侄子远胜朱哈拉。他的父亲是波斯国王，如今他也执掌王权。只有她配得上他，也只有他配得上她。”

paragraphs.en: I plan to give her father rubies and other jewels as a marriage proposal. If al-Shamandal objects because Sayih is a king, remember that Badr is also a king with a larger kingdom and more followers. I will do whatever it takes to fulfill his wish, even if it costs me my life."
paragraphs.zh: 我打算送给她父亲一些红宝石和其他珍珠宝石作为婚聘之礼。如果阿什曼达尔因赛伊赫是国王而反对，记得布达也是国王，而且他的王国更大，追随者更多。为了实现他的愿望，我愿意付出一切，哪怕代价是我的生命。

paragraphs.en: His mother warned, "Be careful when speaking with al-Shamandal; he has a proud and violent temper, and may harm you."
paragraphs.zh: 他母亲警告道：“和阿什马纳德尔说话时要小心，他的性格骄傲暴躁，可能会伤害你。”

paragraphs.en: Sayih agreed, "I hear and obey."
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫应声道：“我明白了，遵命。”

paragraphs.en: Sayih brought two bags filled with precious necklaces, emeralds, and rubies. He gave them to his servants to carry and set off for al-Shamandal's palace. Upon arrival, he sought permission to see the king.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫带来了两个装满珍贵项链、祖母绿和红宝石的袋子，交给仆人让他们携带，并启程前往阿尔-沙马纳德的宫殿。抵达后，他请求见国王。

paragraphs.en: When granted, Sayih entered, kissed the ground, and greeted him politely.
paragraphs.zh: 当获准进入时，赛伊赫跪地吻土，并礼貌地向他问好。

paragraphs.en: The king rose to return the greeting and invited Sayih to sit down. After sitting, the king asked about his wish. Sayih stood up, kissed the ground again, and addressed the king: "O King of the Age, my mission is for the Almighty God and the brave king, whose fame has spread far and wide.
paragraphs.zh: 国王起身回礼，邀请赛伊赫坐下。坐定后，国王询问他的心愿。赛伊赫站起身来，再次亲吻地面，对国王说道：“哦，时代的英明君主，我的使命是为了至高无上的真主和英勇的国王，其威名远播四方。”

paragraphs.en: I hope you will accept this gift and make me happy."
paragraphs.zh: 我希望你会接受这份礼物，并因此而让我开心。

paragraphs.en: King al-Shamandal replied that such a gift had no reason or explanation. He asked what prompted Sayih to give him this treasure and what he expected in return. Sayih assured the king his need was within his means, stating he would not ask for something impossible.
paragraphs.zh: 国王阿什马纳德回答说，这样的礼物毫无理由可言。他询问赛伊赫为何要赠送给他这份宝藏，并且期望得到什么回报。赛伊赫向国王保证他的需求在自己的能力范围之内，表示自己不会提出任何不切实际的要求。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: Sayih approached King al-Shamandal and said, "The sage advises, 'If you wish to be denied, ask for what can't be supplied,' but my desire is something the king can grant." The king responded, "Explain your request, young man. What do you seek?"
paragraphs.zh: Sayih 走到 al-Shamandal 王面前说：“智者建议，‘如果你希望被拒绝，就请求那些无法提供的东西。’但我的愿望却是国王能够给予的。”国王回应道：“年轻人，请说明你的请求。你究竟想要什么？”

paragraphs.en: Sayih continued, "O King of the age, I come as a suitor for Princess Jauhara, the unique and priceless jewel. O King, fulfill this wish before it disappoints me."
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫接着说：“哦，时代的君王，我作为公主贾乌哈拉的求婚者而来，她是我独一无二、无价之宝。哦，君王，请您成全我的心愿，在它让我失望之前。”

paragraphs.en: Hearing this, the king laughed derisively until he fell back. He then said, "Sayih, I thought you wise and reasonable. What has driven you to seek marriage with a princess from another kingdom?
paragraphs.zh: 听到这话，国王嘲笑道几乎笑倒。他接着说：“赛伊赫，我还以为你是个明智而理性的人呢。是什么让你想要与另一个王国的公主结婚？”

paragraphs.en: Is your pride so high that you dare challenge me?"
paragraphs.zh: 你的傲气如此之高，竟敢向我发起挑战？

paragraphs.en: Sayih replied, "O King, may God guide you. I do not seek your daughter for myself, nor would I if I did, as my father was one of the kings of the sea like you. Our kingdom has been taken from us.
paragraphs.zh: 萨伊赫回答说：“国王陛下，愿真主引导您。我并没有将您的女儿许配给我，即便如此，我也不会这么做，因为我的父亲也是像您一样的海之君王。我们的王国已被夺走。”

paragraphs.en: I seek her for King Badr, the king of Persia, known for his might and fame."
paragraphs.zh: 我为波斯国王巴德尔寻访她，这位以勇武和声望著称的君主。”

paragraphs.en: Sayih continued, "If you object to your greatness, consider that King Badr is greater still. If you doubt her beauty or charm, remember he surpasses her in all these qualities. He excels in discernment, fairness, courtesy, and generosity.
paragraphs.zh: 萨伊赫接着说：“如果你对自己的伟大感到不满，不妨想想国王巴德尔更为显赫。如果你怀疑她的美貌或魅力，那就记住他在这些方面都更胜一筹。他以卓越的判断力、公正、礼貌和慷慨著称。”

paragraphs.en: Grant my request, marry him to your daughter, and do the right thing. Refuse us arrogantly, and you will not treat us fairly."
paragraphs.zh: 满足我们的请求，把你的女儿许配给他，并做件正确的事吧。如果傲慢地拒绝我们，你就不算公平对待我们。

paragraphs.en: King al-Shamandal was furious upon hearing Sayih's words. "O dog," he said, "shall you dare speak thus of my daughter? Who are you, who is your father, sister, or nephew that you should address me so?"
paragraphs.zh: 国王阿什马纳德听罢赛伊赫的话，怒不可遏。“你这个畜生！”他喊道，“你怎么敢如此诋毁我的女儿？你是什么人，你的父兄姐妹或侄子又是谁，竟敢这样对我说话？”

paragraphs.en: The guards drew their swords to attack Sayih, but he fled to the palace gate where his cousins and followers awaited him.
paragraphs.zh: 守卫拔出剑准备攻击赛伊赫，但他逃到了宫殿大门处，那里他的堂兄弟和追随者们正等候着他。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The young man ran to the palace gate, where he found over a thousand relatives and supporters armed with armor and spears. Upon seeing him, they asked what was wrong. He told them about al-Shamandal's actions.
paragraphs.zh: 年轻人跑到宫殿门口，只见那里聚集了上千名亲戚和支持者，个个身披铠甲、手持长矛。见他到来，众人纷纷询问出了何事。他告诉他们阿尔-沙马纳尔的所作所为。

paragraphs.en: Realizing al-Shamandal was arrogant, they dismounted, drew their swords, and entered the throne room with him. Al-Shamandal, seated on his throne, unaware of their arrival, ordered his guards to attack but was quickly defeated and captured.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到阿什马纳德尔傲慢自大，他们翻身下马，拔出剑来，在他身后进入宝座室。阿什马纳德尔正坐在宝座上，丝毫没有察觉他们的到来，命令侍卫攻击，但很快便被击败并俘虏。

paragraphs.en: Upon hearing her father's capture and the deaths of his men, Jauhara fled from the palace to an island. There, she climbed a tree and hid herself away.
paragraphs.zh: 听到父亲被捕以及随行士兵的死讯，贾乌哈拉逃离了王宫，逃到了一个岛上。在那里，她爬到一棵树上躲了起来。

paragraphs.en: Earlier, Sayih's servants informed his mother about the battle. King Badr, realizing he was to blame, fled in fear. He eventually arrived at Jauhara’s hiding place on an island and rested under the tree where she was concealed.
paragraphs.zh: earlier，塞伊赫的仆人向他的母亲报告了战斗的情况。国王巴德尔意识到自己难辞其咎，吓得逃之夭夭。最终，他来到了贾乌哈拉藏身的小岛上，在那棵树下找到了她，并在树荫下歇息。

paragraphs.en: Tired, he lay down, looking up and seeing Princess Jauhara, who appeared as radiant as the moon.
paragraphs.zh: 疲惫不堪，他躺了下来，抬头看见了公主贾乌哈拉，她仿佛皎月般光彩夺目。

paragraphs.en: Badr thought, "Praise be to God for creating such beauty! She must be Princess Jauhara, fleeing from her father's battle with my uncle." He decided to question her.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德心想：“感谢真主创造了如此绝美的女子！她一定是逃亡中的贾乌哈拉公主，正躲避着我叔叔的战斗。”他决定要问清楚。

paragraphs.en: Addressing her, he said, “O fairest of all women, who are you and how did you come here?” Jauhara replied, recognizing his youth and good looks, "I am Princess Jauhara, daughter of King al-Shamandal. Sayih and his men attacked my father, killing most of his men and taking him prisoner.
paragraphs.zh: 他对她说道：“你是最美的女子，你是谁？又是如何来到这里的？”贾乌哈拉回答道，认出了他的年轻与英俊，“我是贾乌哈拉公主，国王阿尔-沙马兰德的女儿。塞伊赫和他的人袭击了我的父亲，杀死了大部分士兵，并将我的父亲俘虏了。”

paragraphs.en: I sought refuge here to avoid harm."
paragraphs.zh: 我来到这里是为了躲避祸端。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad paused as morning approached.
paragraphs.zh: 莎赫拉兹在晨光渐近时停了下来。

paragraphs.en: King Badr heard Princess Jauhara's words: "Young man, I feared for my life and fled to this island." He was amazed by the coincidence. "My uncle Sayih must have defeated King al-Shamandal," he thought happily.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德尔听了贾乌哈拉公主的话：“年轻人，我害怕自己的安危，逃到了这个岛上。”他惊讶于这种巧合。“我的叔叔赛伊赫一定已经击败了沙马兰德国王了，”他心中暗喜。

paragraphs.en: "I've achieved my goal by capturing her father."
paragraphs.zh: “我通过俘虏她的父亲达成了目的。”

paragraphs.en: Turning to Jauhara, Badr said, "O my lady, come down to me. You have captured my heart with your beauty and love." He explained that their meeting was a rare coincidence.
paragraphs.zh: 转向贾乌哈拉，巴德说：“哦，我的夫人，请下来吧。你以你的美貌和爱情俘获了我的心。”他解释说他们的相遇纯属罕见的巧合。

paragraphs.en: As Badr of Persia, his uncle Sayih had come to demand Jauhara's hand in marriage for him. He left his kingdom and loved ones to seek her.
paragraphs.zh: 作为波斯的巴德，他的叔叔赛伊赫为了给他提亲贾乌哈拉而前来。他离开了自己的王国和亲人，只为寻找她。

paragraphs.en: "Come down," he continued, "and I will take you back to your father’s palace. Ask my uncle to release him, and we can be lawful husband and wife."
paragraphs.zh: “下来吧，”他继续说道，“我会带你回到你父亲的宫殿。请我叔叔放了他，我们就可以名正言顺地结为夫妇了。”

paragraphs.en: When Jauhara heard this, she thought to herself that her father's army had been defeated because of this worthless coward. She decided to deceive him with sweet words and coquettish behavior. "O my lord, O my darling," she said, "are you indeed King Badr, the son of Jullanar of the Sea?"
paragraphs.zh: 贾乌哈拉听到这话后，心中暗自思量，父亲的军队是因为这个无能的懦夫而失败。她决定用甜言蜜语和娇柔造作来欺骗他。“哦，我的主啊，哦，我心爱的人，”她说，“你真的是海之珠兰娜的女儿巴德尔国王吗？”

paragraphs.en: He confirmed it. She replied, "May God cut off your father's hand and take his kingdom from him! How could he desire anyone more handsome or elegant than you?
paragraphs.zh: 他确认道：“愿上帝砍下你父亲的手，并夺走他的王位！他怎么会希望有比你更加英俊、优雅的人呢？”

paragraphs.en: By God, he has little sense." Then she embraced and kissed him, making his love for her grow stronger.
paragraphs.zh: 天哪，他真是个不懂事的家伙。”然后她拥抱并吻了他，这让她对他的爱意更加强烈。

paragraphs.en: But morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 但是晨光初现，沙赫拉兹便沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that King Badr said, "Or a carat of her beauty." Suddenly, Jauhara pressed him to her bosom and spat in his face. She commanded, "Leave your human form and turn into the prettiest bird with white feathers and red bill and feet."
paragraphs.zh: 我听说国王巴德说：“或者是一颗她美貌的结晶。”突然，贾乌哈拉将他拥入怀中，朝他的脸上吐了口唾沫。她命令道：“脱下你的人形，变成一只最美丽的白羽红喙红脚的鸟儿。”

paragraphs.en: Instantly, King Badr transformed into a beautiful bird, which stood before Princess Jauhara.
paragraphs.zh: 瞬间，国王巴德尔回化为一只美丽的鸟儿，站在了贾乌哈拉公主面前。

paragraphs.en: Princess Jauhara instructed one of her maids to disguise the king's uncle as a bird and carry him to the Island of Thirst. The maid, moved by his beauty, instead left him on a lush green island with abundant trees and water before returning to Jauhara.
paragraphs.zh: 公主贾乌哈拉吩咐其中一个侍女将国王的叔叔化装成一只鸟，带他飞往干渴岛。侍女被他的英俊所打动，没有按指示行事，而是把他放到了一个绿意盎然、树木繁茂且水源充足的岛上，然后返回了贾乌哈拉身边。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Sayih, King Badr’s uncle, had captured King al-Shamandal after killing his guards. He searched for his nephew but found no trace of Jauhara either. Upon learning that Badr had fled, Sayih grieved deeply and feared for his safety or the consequences if Jauhara were to capture him.
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，萨伊赫——巴德国王的叔叔，在杀死了阿什马曼达尔国王的卫兵后将其俘获。他四处寻找侄子贾乌哈拉，却连她的踪迹也未发现。得知巴德逃走的消息后，萨伊赫痛心疾首，生怕她会因此对他不利或遭到报复。

paragraphs.en: Sayih sent officers to search the sea for King Badr, but they returned empty-handed. Disheartened, he kept al-Shamandal imprisoned on his mother’s palace while continuing to mourn his nephew's fate.
paragraphs.zh: 赛伊赫派官员出海寻找_bad_拉德，但一无所获。失望之余，他继续将_al-沙马纳尔_囚禁在母亲的宫殿中，并为外甥的命运哀悼不已。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad paused as morning approached.
paragraphs.zh: 莎赫拉兹在晨光渐近时停了下来。

paragraphs.en: Queen Jullanar waited anxiously for her son after he left with his uncle. After days of no news, she descended into the sea to visit her mother's palace. Upon arrival, her mother greeted her warmly, as did her cousins.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳女王焦急地等待着儿子，他在叔叔陪同下离开了。几天没有音信后，她潜入海底前往母亲的宫殿探望。一到那里，母亲便热情地迎接了她，她的堂兄弟姐妹们也一样。

paragraphs.en: Her mother informed her that King Badr had come with his uncle, who proposed a marriage alliance with al-Shamandal for their son. Al-Shamandal refused and attacked, leading to a battle where Jullanar’s brother defeated al-Shamandal but lost contact with Badr.
paragraphs.zh: 她母亲告诉她，国王巴德及其叔叔来访，并提议与沙马兰达结成婚约。沙马兰达拒绝了这一提议并发动攻击，导致一场战斗。在战斗中，朱拉纳尔的哥哥击败了沙马兰达，但失去了与巴德的消息联系。

paragraphs.en: Grieving for her son, Jullanar was angry at Sayih for taking him without permission. She feared for the kingdom's safety and decided to return soon to manage affairs until God resolved the matter. Her mother promised to search for Badr as well.
paragraphs.zh: 因思念儿子，朱兰娜对萨伊赫未经允许就将儿子带走的行为感到愤怒。她担心王国的安全，决定尽快返回，处理事务直到上帝解决此事。她的母亲则承诺也会去找巴德。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that Jullanar’s mother sent men to find King Badr while his mother returned to her kingdom in tears, feeling sad and worried about their son's fate.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说朱拉纳的母亲派人去找国王巴德尔，而她则泪眼婆娑地返回了自己的王国，心中满是为儿子命运担忧的悲伤。

paragraphs.en: Badr stayed on the island as a bird for several days, eating fruits and drinking water but unable to fly or find his way. One day, a bird catcher approached, marveling at Badr's striking appearance—white feathers, red bill, and feet that dazzled him. The catcher caught Badr in his net and took him to the city, intending to sell him.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德在岛上化身为一只鸟，连续几天以果实为食、饮水解渴，却无法飞翔也无法找到回家的路。有一天，一位捕鸟人走近，惊叹于巴德那引人注目的 appearance——雪白的羽毛、鲜红的喙和令他目眩神迷的双脚。捕鸟人将巴德捉入网中，带到了城市里，打算将其卖掉。

paragraphs.en: At the market, a man asked about the price of the bird. When he suggested killing it for food, the catcher refused, saying he would present it to the king instead, who would value its beauty far more than its worth. The catcher went to the palace and waited with the bird until the king noticed its unique features.
paragraphs.zh: 在市场上，一个男人询问那只鸟的价格。当他说可以把鸟杀了当食物时，捕鸟人拒绝了，表示他会把鸟献给国王，而国王会更加珍视它的美丽远胜于其价值。捕鸟人随后前往王宫，带着鸟等待国王注意到它那独特的特征。

paragraphs.en: The king was captivated by Badr's appearance and ordered a servant to buy him for ten dinars. The servant brought the bird back to the palace, where it was placed in a handsome cage with food and water provided.
paragraphs.zh: 国王被巴德的英姿所吸引，下令一名仆人以十迪纳尔的价格将它买下。仆人把这只鸟带回王宫，将其安置在一个漂亮的笼子里，并提供了食物和水。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, when the servant brought the cage to the king, he noticed the food untouched and wondered what the bird would eat. The king continued to admire the bird's beauty as he ate his own meal. Seeing the bird fly down from its cage and feast on bread, meat, sweets, and fruits, everyone was amazed.
paragraphs.zh: 亲爱的大王，当仆人把笼子送到大王面前时，他发现食物都没有动过，不禁好奇那鸟儿会吃什么。大王一边享用自己的餐食，一边继续赞叹那只小鸟的美丽。只见小鸟从笼子里飞下来，大快朵颐地享受着面包、肉类、甜点和水果，所有人都为之惊叹不已。

paragraphs.en: The king called for his wife to see this wonder. A servant informed her: "O my lady, the king wishes you to come and see a bird that has eaten all the food placed before him."
paragraphs.zh: 国王召来王后，让她来看这个奇迹。一个仆人禀告道：“夫人，国王希望您来看看那只吃光了面前所有食物的鸟。”

paragraphs.en: When the queen arrived, she veiled her face and turned away. The king asked why she fled, but she insisted it was not a bird but King Badr, son of Jullanar of the Sea.
paragraphs.zh: 女王一到，便蒙上面纱，扭头避开。国王问她为何逃避，但她坚持那不是一只鸟，而是海之女王朱拉纳尔的儿子巴德尔王。

paragraphs.en: The king, amused by his wife's jest, replied: "You are joking; how can a bird be a man? You must be telling the truth." He then declared, "This bird is indeed King Badr, the king of Persia and the son of Jullanar of the Sea."
paragraphs.zh: 国王被王后的话逗乐了，回答说：“你在开玩笑吧？鸟怎么能变成人呢？你一定是认真的。”随后他宣布：“这只鸟果然是波斯的国王巴德尔，也就是海之女王朱拉纳尔的儿子。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德开口说道：

paragraphs.en: "O happy King, the queen told you that King Badr, son of Jullanar of the Sea, had been enchanted by Princess Jauhara. She demanded his hand in marriage from her father, who refused. Her uncle Sayih then defeated al-Shamandal and imprisoned him."
paragraphs.zh: “哦，幸福的国王，王后告诉您，Badr王子，即海之女王Jullanar的儿子，被公主Jauhara施了魔法。她要求她的父亲将Hand嫁给她，但遭到拒绝。随后，她的叔叔Sayih击败了al-Shamandal，并将其囚禁。”

paragraphs.en: The king was amazed. He said to his wife, "Release him for my sake; do not let him suffer." His queen replied, "King Badr, enter this room," and the bird obeyed.
paragraphs.zh: 国王惊讶不已，他对王后说：“为了我，请放了他，不要让他受苦。”王后回答道：“国王巴德爾，请进这个房间吧。”那只鸟应声而入。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 沙赫拉兹阿德接着说：

paragraphs.en: The queen veiled herself, took a bowl of water, and entered the room. She recited incantations and sprinkled the bird with the water. "By the power of these names and oaths, transform back into your true form," she commanded.
paragraphs.zh: 王后披上面纱，端来一碗水，走进房间。她念诵着咒语，将水洒在小鸟身上。“凭借这些名字和誓言的力量，变回你真正的模样。”她命令道。

paragraphs.en: The bird shook violently and transformed into a handsome young man.
paragraphs.zh: 鸟儿剧烈颤抖，化作一个英俊的年轻人。

paragraphs.en: The king was astounded to see his prisoner before him in human form.
paragraphs.zh: 国王见囚犯化作了人形出现在自己面前，惊讶不已。

paragraphs.en: Badr looked at himself and exclaimed, "Glory be to God!" He then kissed the king's hands and feet, saying, "May God reward you." The king responded by kissing Badr’s head and asked, “King Badr, tell me your entire story.”
paragraphs.zh: 巴德尔回头看了看自己，不禁脱口而出：“愿真主保佑！”随后他亲吻了国王的手和脚，说道：“愿真主赐福于您。”国王则回吻了巴德尔的额头，并问道：“巴德尔国王，请把你的整个故事告诉我吧。”

paragraphs.en: Badr recounted his tale without reservation. Impressed, the king inquired, “What do you intend to do now?” Badr replied, “O King of the Age, I seek a ship with servants and necessities to return home and reclaim my kingdom.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德尔回忆起他的故事，毫无保留。国王听后 impressed，问道：“你现在打算怎么办？”巴德尔回答道：“陛下，请您赐予一艘船以及随行人员和必需品，让我能够返回家乡，重新夺回我的王国。”

paragraphs.en: I fear losing it due to prolonged absence from my mother and subjects.” The king granted his request.
paragraphs.zh: “我担心长期远离母亲和臣民会导致我失去理智。”国王批准了他的请求。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued her tale: She heard that Badr asked the king and queen for one more favor—equipping him for the journey. Moved by his beauty and eloquence, the king agreed, fitting out a ship with all necessities and a company of servants.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹德继续讲述她的故事：她听说巴德尔向国王和王后提出了一个额外的要求——为他的旅程做准备。国王被他的英俊与口才所打动，欣然应允，安排了一艘船，并配备了所需的一切以及一队仆人。

paragraphs.en: Badr bid farewell and set sail under fair winds for ten days. On the eleventh day, the wind grew stronger, and the sea raged. The ship struggled, and sailors could not control her.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德与众人告别，乘着顺风扬帆出海航行了十天。第十一天，风势突然增强，海面汹涌澎湃。船只摇晃不已，水手们也无法掌控局面。

paragraphs.en: They drifted until hitting a rock, breaking apart. Some drowned, while others escaped. Badr clung to a plank after nearly drowning.
paragraphs.zh: 他们随波逐流，最终撞上了一块岩石，船只四分五裂。有些人溺水身亡，而另一些人则得以逃生。巴德紧紧抓住一块木板，险些丧命。

paragraphs.en: For three nights and days, he drifted with waves, unaware of direction or destination. On the fourth day, the waves cast him ashore.
paragraphs.zh: 连续三天三夜，他随波逐流，完全不知方向与目的地。到了第四天，海浪将他冲上了岸。

paragraphs.en: King Badr approached a city resembling a white dove, with towering structures built on water. Starving and thirsty, he attempted to climb ashore but was repelled by numerous mules, asses, and horses. Disappointed, he swam around the city and found it deserted.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德走向一座宛如白鸽的城市，高耸的建筑矗立在水上。饥渴难耐的他试图登岸，却被众多骡子、驴和马匹挡了回来。失望之余，他在城周围游了一圈，发现这里空无一人。

paragraphs.en: One night, Shahrazad paused her storytelling as dawn approached.
paragraphs.zh: 一天清晨即将来临的时候，沙赫拉兹暂停了她的讲述。

paragraphs.en: The next evening, Shahrazad resumed: She heard that King Badr encountered an old fava-bean seller in his shop. The king recounted his journey to the city, which was empty of inhabitants. Astonished, the old man invited him inside and offered food, warning him about the dangers of the City of the Magicians.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹继续讲述：她听说国王巴德尔在店铺里遇到了一位年迈的鹰嘴豆卖家。国王讲述了他前往那座空无一人的城市的经历。老人惊讶地邀请国王进屋，并请他吃饭，同时警告他关于巫师之城的危险。

paragraphs.en: The old man explained that the queen was a powerful enchantress who turned young men into beasts for forty days before consuming them. King Badr, frightened but relieved by the meal, listened intently to this ominous tale.
paragraphs.zh: 老者解释说，那位女王是一位强大的巫术施法者，在四十天内将年轻男子变成野兽，然后再吞噬他们。国王巴德在餐后虽然仍感到害怕，但心情有所缓解，他全神贯注地聆听着这个令人不安的故事。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad spoke:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹德说道：

paragraphs.en: I heard, O happy king, that the old man said: "She casts a spell on him, turning him into an animal like one of those you saw. When sorcerers from the city need to travel, they ride these beasts, which kicked you out of pity. Don't climb near the shore; she might cast a spell on you as she did them.
paragraphs.zh: 我听见，幸福的国王啊，老人说道：“她对他施了魔法，把他变成了像你们刚才看到的那种动物。城里的巫师需要外出时会骑这些 beast ，出于怜悯才把你踢开了。不要靠近岸边；她可能会对你施展同样的魔法。”

paragraphs.en: Her name is Lab, meaning 'the Sun.'" King Badr was terrified and pondered his next move. Seeing him frightened, the old man advised: "Go sit by the shop door to count the city's inhabitants.
paragraphs.zh: 她的名字叫拉卜，意为“太阳”。“国王巴德尔吓得不轻，陷入了沉思。见他如此惊恐，老人劝道：‘你去坐在店门口数数城里的居民吧。’”

paragraphs.en: They respect me and won't harm you."
paragraphs.zh: 他们尊重我，不会伤害你。

paragraphs.en: Morning came before Shahrazad could continue.
paragraphs.zh: 沙赫拉兹德还没来得及继续讲述，天就亮了。

paragraphs.en: The following night, Sbahrazad began:
paragraphs.zh: 当晚，赛巴赫拉兹开始说道：

paragraphs.en: [The narrative continues with a new speaker, but no further details are provided in this excerpt.]
paragraphs.zh: 故事继续由新的叙述者讲述，但本摘录中未提供更多信息。

paragraphs.en: King Badr sat at the shop door, observing passersby. Noticing his beauty, people approached and asked if he was the latest captive. He explained that the young man was his brother's son living far away, whom he had brought to ease his grief after learning of the boy’s father's death.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德尔坐在店铺门口，观察着过往的人们。当他意识到有人注意到了他的外貌时，这些人便上前询问他是否是最近被俘虏的那个人。巴德尔回答说，那个年轻人其实是他弟弟的儿子，住在很远的地方，自己把他带来是为了缓解得知那孩子父亲去世后的悲痛。

paragraphs.en: They warned him about Queen Lab, fearing she might take the handsome youth from him. King Badr reassured them, saying the queen respected and liked him, so she would not bother or harm the young man.
paragraphs.zh: 他们警告他小心拉卜女王，担心她可能会抢走这位英俊的少年。_badr国王宽慰他们说，女王尊敬并且喜欢他，所以不会去招惹或伤害这个年轻人。_

paragraphs.en: For a full month, King Badr stayed with the old man, sharing meals and forming a close bond.
paragraphs.zh: 一个月下来，巴德国王与老人同吃同住，两人关系日益亲密。

paragraphs.en: One day, King Badr sat at the shop door when a thousand officers on gilded saddled Arabian horses passed by. They saluted him, and he returned their salute. Following them were a thousand Mamluks in attendant uniforms with jeweled belts and drawn swords, who also greeted the old man.
paragraphs.zh: 一天，国王巴德尔坐在店铺门口，忽然一群骑士骑着金鞍华马从他眼前经过，共有千人之多。他们向他致敬，他也回礼致意。紧随其后的是另一批身穿侍从制服、腰佩宝石belt并拔出宝剑的上千名马穆鲁克武士，他们也向这位老人问好。

paragraphs.en: Then came a thousand girls like moons, dressed in silk robes embroidered with gold, armed with shields and spears. In their midst rode the queen on an Arabian horse, her saddle set with rubies and jewels.
paragraphs.zh: 随后，一千个女孩如月亮般美丽，身穿绣金丝绸长袍，手持盾牌和长矛。她们中间，女王骑着一匹阿拉伯马，马鞍上镶嵌着红宝石和其他珍珠宝石。

paragraphs.en: The queen's entourage halted before King Badr’s shop. The girls saluted him, and he returned their salute. Then the queen approached, saluting him.
paragraphs.zh: 女王的随从在Badr国王的店铺前停了下来。女孩们向他行礼，他也回礼致意。随后，女王走近，向他行了一个礼。

paragraphs.en: He rose to his feet, kissed the ground, and stood respectfully. She asked, "O Abu 'Abd-Allah, is this handsome young man your captive? When did you catch him?"
paragraphs.zh: 他站起身来，亲吻了地面，然后恭敬地站立着。她问道：“阿布·阿卜杜拉赫，这位英俊的年轻人是你的俘虏吗？你什么时候捉到他的？”

paragraphs.en: King Badr replied, "No by God, O Queen, he is my brother's son who had been long absent. I brought him here to satisfy my longing and dispel my loneliness because I love him very much. Besides, as an old man with a deceased father, his presence will help me during my lifetime and inherit my estate after my death."
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德回答说：“绝不是这样，哦女王，他是我弟弟的儿子，已经很久没有回家了。我把他也带来这里，是为了慰藉我的思念之情，排解孤独之苦，因为我非常爱他。此外，作为一个失去父亲的老人，在世时有他的陪伴可以让我感到安慰，而在我去世后，他也能继承我的产业。”

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹又开始了她的讲述：

paragraphs.en: O happy King, the queen spoke to the old man: "Father, give him to me as a gift; I love him. By fire and light, by hot wind and cool shade, he will be my life companion. Fear not for him, for though I can harm all, I will not harm him."
paragraphs.zh: 幸福的国王啊，王后对老人说道：“父亲，请把这个人送给我作为礼物；我爱他。无论烈火与光明、热风与凉荫，他都将是我生命中的伴侣。你无需为他担心，因为我虽能伤害一切，却不会伤他。”

paragraphs.en: The old man replied, "O Queen, neither can I give nor surrender him."
paragraphs.zh: 老者回答说：“哦，女王，我既不能给予他，也无法将他交出。”

paragraphs.en: She swore she would not harm or enchant the young man and promised to return him as received. The old man secured her oath and said, "Tomorrow when you return from the square, I will give him to you." She thanked him and went back to her palace.
paragraphs.zh: 她发誓不会伤害或施魔法于这位年轻人，并承诺按原样归还给他。老人收下了她的誓言，说：“明天你从广场回来时，我会把他交给你。”她向他道谢后，返回了自己的宫殿。

paragraphs.en: The old man then turned to King Badr: "This is the woman I feared, but she swore not to harm or enchant you by her faith. If it were not for my respect, she would have taken you by force. Such is the custom of this witch-queen."
paragraphs.zh: 老人随后转向巴德国王：“这就是我担心的女子，但她发誓不会以她的信仰伤害或迷惑你。如果不是因为我尊重她，她早就用武力将你劫持了。这正是这个女巫女王的习惯。”

paragraphs.en: The king replied, "My lord, I am terrified; Princess Jauhara from King al-Shamandal's court enchanted me for a month until another king's wife freed me. I know the suffering of enchantment."
paragraphs.zh: 国王回答道：“我的lord，我感到恐惧；贾乌哈拉公主让我着了魔一个月，直到另一位国王的妻子才解救了我。我知道被魔法束缚的痛苦。”

paragraphs.en: The old man comforted him: "Fear not, she may harm relatives but not me." But Shahrazad was overtaken by morning and fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 老人安慰他说：“别怕，她可能会伤害家人，但不会伤到我。”然而，沙哈拉兹达被晨光打断了思路，沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙哈尔扎德又开始了她的讲述。

paragraphs.en: I heard, O happy King, that the old man told King Badr, "She may harm even her relatives, but she will not dare hurt me. Have you seen how her troops and retinue stood at my shop and saluted me? By God, son, this infidel refuses to salute kings, yet whenever she passes by, she stops to greet me."
paragraphs.zh: 我听说，幸福的国王啊，老人对巴德尔王说：“她甚至可能危害到她的亲戚，但绝不敢对我下手。你看她那些士兵和随从在我店铺前列队行礼的情景吗？真主作证，儿子，这个异教徒连见国王都拒绝行礼，可每当经过这里，她都会停下来向我问好。”

paragraphs.en: That night they slept. The next morning, Queen Lab arrived with her girls, Mamluks, and armed attendants. They stopped before the old man's shop and saluted him.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上他们休息了。第二天一早，女王拉布带着她的侍女、马穆鲁克士兵和武装随从来到了老人的店铺前，并向他行礼致意。

paragraphs.en: He rose, kissed the ground, and returned their greeting.
paragraphs.zh: 他站起身来，亲吻了地面，然后回敬了他们的问候。

paragraphs.en: Queen Lab said, "Father, fulfill your pledge and do as you promised." The old man replied, "Swear again that you will not harm or enchant my nephew."
paragraphs.zh: 女王拉布说：“父亲，履行你的诺言，按你答应的去做。”老人回答道：“再发誓一次，保证不伤害或施魔法于我的侄子。”

paragraphs.en: She swore by her faith, revealing a face like the moon. "Father," she said, "why delay giving me your handsome nephew? Am I not more beautiful than he?"
paragraphs.zh: 她以信仰起誓，露出如月般皎洁的面容。“父亲，”她说，“为何迟迟不将你英俊的侄子许配于我？难道我不比他更美丽吗？”

paragraphs.en: King Badr was enchanted by her beauty and thought, "By God, she is more beautiful than Jauhara. If she marries me, I will leave my kingdom; if not, at least I can enjoy her for forty days."
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德尔被她的美貌深深吸引，心中暗想：“真主啊，她比贾乌哈拉还要美丽。如果她愿意嫁给我，我就放弃我的王位；就算不行，至少我可以享受她四十天。”

paragraphs.en: The old man then took King Badr's hand and said to Queen Lab, "Receive my nephew Badr and return him as you receive him. Do not harm or take him from me." She swore again that she would not harm or enchant him.
paragraphs.zh: 老人随后握住了巴德国王的手，对拉卜王后说：“请收下我的侄子巴德，并像对待他一样对待他。不要伤害或带走他。”拉卜再次发誓，绝不会伤害或施魔法于他。

paragraphs.en: She ordered a handsome, gold-trimmed horse for Badr and gave the old man a thousand dinars.
paragraphs.zh: 她下令为巴德准备一匹英俊的、镶有金边的骏马，并给了老者一千第纳尔。

paragraphs.en: But morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 但是晨光初现，沙赫拉兹便沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: O happy King, after the queen gave the old fava-bean seller a thousand dinars, she took King Badr to the palace. The people felt sorry for him as he rode beside her, his beauty shining like the moon. Upon reaching the gate, the princes and nobles dismounted, while she and King Badr entered the throne room.
paragraphs.zh: 哦，幸福的国王！王后给了那个年迈的鹰嘴豆卖家一千第纳尔后，便带着国王巴德走进了宫殿。人们见他骑马跟在她身旁，英姿勃发，犹如明月一般，心中不禁生出怜悯之情。抵达大门时，王子和贵族们纷纷下马，而王后与国王巴德则步入了宝座大厅。

paragraphs.en: Inside, the palace was opulent, with walls of gold and storerooms filled with clothes and vessels. A beautiful garden in the center featured a large pond and singing birds. King Badr marveled at the splendor, thinking of God's generosity.
paragraphs.zh: 宫殿内部华贵无比，金壁辉煌，储藏室里堆满了各式衣物和器具。中央是一个美丽的花园，园中有一片宽阔的池塘，还有鸣叫的鸟儿。国王巴德尔惊叹于这奢华景象，心中不禁感慨上天的慷慨。

paragraphs.en: Queen Lab sat on an ivory couch by a window overlooking the garden, embracing and kissing King Badr. They ate from a table set with jewels and pearls, then drank wine from golden and silver vessels. Servants brought dried fruits, nuts, flowers, and perfumes.
paragraphs.zh: 女王拉卜坐在窗前俯瞰花园的象牙沙发上，紧紧拥抱着国王巴德，并亲吻着他。他们用餐时使用的是一张铺满宝石和珍珠的桌子，随后又用金杯和银杯饮酒。仆人们端上了干果、坚果、鲜花和香料。

paragraphs.en: But morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 但是晨光初现，沙赫拉兹便沉默了下来。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad began again:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹又开始了她的讲述：

paragraphs.en: I heard, O happy King, that Queen Lab gave King Badr a cup, which he drank. They continued drinking until they became intoxicated. She then ordered the girls to sing, and they performed various songs.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说，幸福的国王啊，王后拉布给国王巴德赐了一杯酒，他一饮而尽。他们继续饮酒，直至酩酊大醉。随后她命令女侍唱歌，她们唱起了各种各样的歌曲。

paragraphs.en: King Badr felt as if the palace was dancing with him, becoming lightheaded and forgetting his home. He thought, "By God, this queen is young and beautiful; I will never leave her." They drank through the night until most of it had passed, and Queen Lab dismissed the singers.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德感觉宫殿仿佛与他共舞，头晕目眩，竟忘了归途。他心想：“天哪，这位女王年轻而美丽；我永远不会离开她。”他们整夜畅饮，直到大半夜晚过去，王后拉布才遣散了乐师。

paragraphs.en: She then asked King Badr to lie beside her in bed. The maids removed all his clothes except a gold-embroidered shirt, similar to Queen Lab's. They spent a joyful night together before dawn. Queen Lab took King Badr to the palace bath, where they washed and dressed him.
paragraphs.zh: 她随后请国王巴德在床边躺下。侍女们除了给他留下一件金线绣花的衬衫，其余衣物全部脱去，这件衬衫与拉卜王后所穿的颇为相似。两人共度了一个愉快的夜晚，直到黎明前才休息。次日清晨，拉卜王后带着国王巴德前往宫殿浴室，为他沐浴更衣。

paragraphs.en: They drank wine as she led him back to the banquet room.
paragraphs.zh: 她领着他回到宴会厅，两人边走边喝着酒。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued her story: The queen and king sat and rested after bathing. Maids brought them food, which they ate and washed their hands. Then the maids cleared the table and set out wine, fruits, nuts, and flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙赫拉兹继续讲述她的故事：王后和国王沐浴之后坐下来休息。侍女们端来了食物，他们用餐并洗手。随后，侍女们撤走了桌子，摆上了酒、水果、坚果和鲜花。

paragraphs.en: They drank while singers performed until nightfall.
paragraphs.zh: 他们边喝边听歌手表演，直到夜幕降临。

paragraphs.en: King Badr and Queen Lab continued their blissful days for forty days. One morning, after a particularly joyful night, he woke to find her gone. Feeling lonely, he searched the garden but found only a black bird next to a white she-bird under a large tree.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德和王后拉布继续享受着幸福的日子，一连四十天。一天早晨，在一个特别愉快的夜晚之后，他醒来时发现她不见了。感到孤独的他四处寻找，但只在一棵大树下找到了一只黑鸟，旁边还有一只白雌鸟。

paragraphs.en: The black bird leaped three times before the she-bird transformed into Queen Lab. Realizing his love had been deceived, King Badr felt jealous and angry.
paragraphs.zh: 黑鸟跳了三下，雌鸟随即化作了女王拉布。意识到自己的爱被欺骗了，国王巴德感到既嫉妒又愤怒。

paragraphs.en: Returning to their chambers, he lay in bed, and soon Queen Lab came to him, kissing and joking as usual. But when he remained silent, she guessed his anger stemmed from what he had seen. She kept her secret, saying nothing.
paragraphs.zh: 回到各自的房间后，他躺在床上，Queen Lab不久也来到了他的房间，像往常一样亲吻着他，开玩笑。但当他沉默不语时，她猜到了他的怒气是因为刚才所见之事。她守口如瓶，什么也没有说。

paragraphs.en: The next morning, King Badr asked for leave to visit his uncle's shop, eager to see him after forty days. Queen Lab allowed it but urged him not to stay long. Mounted on his horse, he rode away.
paragraphs.zh: 第二天一早，国王巴德请求假条去拜访叔叔的店铺，四十多天没见，他迫不及待想见叔叔一面。王后拉布答应了，但叮嘱他不要待太久。骑上马，巴德扬长而去。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad fell silent, leaving the story hanging.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙赫拉兹默不作声，故事戛然而止。

paragraphs.en: King Badr visited the shop of an old fava-bean seller who greeted him warmly. After inquiring about his well-being, Badr shared that he had not seen Jullanar last night and searched for her until finding a black bird near her. The old man warned Badr to beware, explaining that Jullanar had turned young strangers into birds she loved, including the black one, who was once her Mamluk in love.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德访问了一位老鹰豆卖家的店铺，对方热情地迎接了他。寒暄过后，巴德提到昨晚没有见到朱拉纳，直到找到一只黑鸟才发现了她的踪迹。老人警告巴德要小心提防，解释说朱拉纳将一些年轻的陌生人变成了她所爱的鸟儿，包括那只黑鸟，它曾是她心爱的马穆鲁克。

paragraphs.en: When the bird saw another woman, Jullanar cast a spell turning him into a bird. She would turn into a female bird and allow the black bird to mount her out of love. The old man assured Badr he could protect him from Jullanar's schemes.
paragraphs.zh: 当那只鸟看到另一个女人时，朱兰娜施了一个咒语，将其变成了一只鸟。她自己则化作一只雌鸟，让黑鸟出于爱意与她交配。老汉向巴德保证，他可以保护巴德免受朱兰娜的阴谋。

paragraphs.en: Badr left the shop and returned to the queen. He planned to feign ignorance until the next day, when he would seek advice from the old man on how to handle Jullanar.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德离开了店铺，回到王后身边。他打算暂时装作不知情，等到第二天再向那位老者求教，看看该如何应对朱拉纳尔公主。

paragraphs.en: Jullanar greeted Shahrazad upon his arrival and they ate together before drinking wine until he was drunk by midnight. Jullanar then confessed to searching for her in a garden where he found her as a white bird with a black one on her, which turned into human form afterward.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔在沙赫拉兹德到来时迎接了他，他们一起用餐，随后喝起了葡萄酒，直到午夜时分沙赫拉兹德已醉意朦胧。接着，朱拉纳尔回忆起他在一个花园中寻找她的经历，在那里他发现她化身为一只白鸟，身旁还有一只黑鸟，后来那两只鸟都变成了人形。

paragraphs.en: Morning came, and Shahrazad fell silent.
paragraphs.zh: 晨光初现，沙赫拉兹德默然不语。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad recounted:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，舍赫拉查德说道：

paragraphs.en: Queen Badraz told King Badr that they loved each other deeply. Drunk, the king agreed. She then embraced him, pretended to love him, and went to sleep beside him.
paragraphs.zh: 女王巴德拉兹告诉国王巴德拉，他们彼此深爱着。酒意蒙眬中，国王答应了她。随后，她拥抱了他，假装深深地爱着他，并在他身边躺下睡去。

paragraphs.en: In the middle of the night, she rose quietly while he feigned sleep. She spread red sand on the floor, which transformed into a stream. She sowed barley in the soil by the stream, watered it with the stream's water, reaped the barley, ground it into meal, and returned to bed beside the king until morning.
paragraphs.zh: 在一个宁静的夜晚，她悄悄起身，而他装作熟睡。她将红砂铺在地上，仿佛化作了潺潺流水。随后她在溪边的土地上撒下了大麦种子，并用溪水浇灌。待到收获时节，她将大麦磨成面粉，直到天亮才回到国王身边。

paragraphs.en: King Badr rose early and sought permission from Jullanar to visit the old man. She granted him leave, and he went to the old man with his findings.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德起个大早，请求朱兰娜女士允许他去拜访那位老者。她应允了，于是他带着自己的发现前往见那老者。

paragraphs.en: The old man laughed upon hearing what Badr had seen. "By God, this infidel is plotting mischief against you," he said, but advised, "Do not mind her." He then gave Badr half a pound of barley meal, instructing him to take it and use it as follows: when Jullanar asked about the meal, Badr should reply, "An extra blessing is a blessing," and eat some himself.
paragraphs.zh: 老人听罢巴德的讲述，不禁笑了起来。“天哪，这个异教徒对你图谋不轨呢。”他说道，但随即劝慰道：“别放在心上。”随后，他递给巴德半磅大麦粉，并嘱咐说：“等朱拉纳问起这事儿时，你就告诉她‘额外的祝福也是一种福气’，自己也吃一点。”

paragraphs.en: If she brought more for him, he was to pretend eating her meal but consume his instead.
paragraphs.zh: 如果她再为他准备一些，他只需假装吃她的那份，实际上却享用自己的。

paragraphs.en: Badr was warned that if he ate even a dirham's weight or a grain of hers, Jullanar’s spell would take hold. However, if he remained steadfast, her magic would fail, and she would reveal her true intentions. The old man advised Badr to show love and invite her to taste his meal, then throw water in her face if she did.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德被告知，如果他吃了哪怕一迪拉姆重或一粒她的东西，朱拉丁娜的咒语就会生效。但如果他坚守不动摇，她的魔法便会失效，她的真实意图也会暴露无遗。老人建议巴德表现出爱意，请她品尝自己的饭菜，若她真的尝了，就向她脸上泼水。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the old man instructed Badr to return to him after dealing with Jullanar, assuring he would take care of him.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，老人吩咐巴德在处理完朱拉纳尔后回来找他，并保证他会好好照顾自己。

paragraphs.en: King Badr returned to the palace after bidding farewell to the old man. Upon seeing him, Queen Badr welcomed him with a kiss, saying he had been away too long. He explained that his uncle gave him barley meal, but she insisted they had better food.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德尔回到王宫，向那老人告别后。一见到他，王后巴德尔回头亲吻他，说他离开得太久了。他解释说叔叔给了他一些燕麦粉，但她坚持他们有更好的食物。

paragraphs.en: She placed her meal in one dish and his in another, urging him to eat hers instead. Pretending to eat, he waited for her to sprinkle water on him as a spell. However, nothing changed when she called him a worthless mule.
paragraphs.zh: 她把食物分别盛在两个盘子里，劝他吃她的那份。他假装进食，等待她洒水施法。然而，当他被称作一匹无用的驴时，情况并没有改变。

paragraphs.en: Realizing the spell failed, she kissed him, saying she had only teased him. King Badr reassured her that his love would not change.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到咒语失效了，她吻了他，轻描淡写地说只是跟他开了个玩笑。国王巴德尔向她保证，他的爱不会因此改变。

paragraphs.en: That night, Shahrazad fell silent, leaving the story unfinished.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，沙赫拉兹默不作声，故事也戛然而止。

paragraphs.en: King Badr told the queen, "As long as you love me, nothing will change my feelings toward you." She ate some barley meal he offered. Soon, she began to convulse.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德对王后说：“只要你爱我，我的感情就不会改变。”她吃了一些他提供的燕麦粉。很快，她的身体开始抽搐起来。

paragraphs.en: Badr then threw water on her face and commanded, "Turn into a dappled she-mule." Instantly, she transformed.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，巴德往她脸上洒了些水，命令道：“变成一匹斑点母驴。”话音刚落，她便瞬间变了模样。

paragraphs.en: Seeing herself in this form, the queen wept and rubbed against his feet. Badr tried to bridle her but failed. He went to an old man who gave him a bridle, saying it would make her submit.
paragraphs.zh: 看到自己变成这样，女王不禁泪流满面，紧紧依偎在他的脚边。巴德试图控制她，但未能如愿。他去找了一位老者，老者给了他一个缰绳，并说这会让她屈服。

paragraphs.en: With the bridle, Badr returned to the queen, who approached him. He bridled her and rode away.
paragraphs.zh: 缰绳在手，巴德返回到王后身边，王后走近他。巴德为她备好了马，然后纵马而去。

paragraphs.en: At the shop, the old man scolded the queen: "May God shame you! Look at what has happened to you." To King Badr, he advised, "It's time for you to leave this city.
paragraphs.zh: 在店铺里，老者责备王后：“但愿上帝羞辱你！看看你现在成了什么样子。”他对国王巴德尔说道，“是时候让你离开这座城市了。”

paragraphs.en: Ride her wherever you like but keep the bridle."
paragraphs.zh: 任你驰骋，但请别忘了牵着她的缰绳。

paragraphs.en: Badr thanked him and departed with his new mount.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德向他道谢后，便骑上新得的坐骑离开了。

paragraphs.en: King Badr rode for three days until he reached a city where an old gray-headed man greeted him. The man asked, "Son, where are you coming from?" King Badr replied, "From the City of the Magicians."
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德骑马前行了三天，终于抵达一座城市，在这里一位满头白发的老者迎上了他。老者问道：“年轻人，你从哪里来？”国王巴德回答说：“我来自巫师之城。”

paragraphs.en: The old man said, "You are my guest," but before they could talk further, an old woman approached and wept over his she-mule. She claimed it resembled her dead son's mule and begged to buy it for a thousand dinars.
paragraphs.zh: 老人说道：“你是我的客人。”但还没等他们多说什么，一位老妇人走过来，泪流满面地抚摸着他的母驴。她声称这头母驴像已故儿子的那匹母驴，并恳求以一千第纳尔买下它。

paragraphs.en: King Badr reluctantly agreed, saying he would sell the she-mule only for that amount. The old woman produced the money from her pocket, and King Badr realized he had been tricked. He dismounted from the she-mule.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德勉强答应了，说只能以那个价格卖掉这只母驴。老妇人从口袋里掏出钱来，国王巴德这才意识到自己上了当。他从母驴背上跳了下来。

paragraphs.en: Shahrazad paused as morning approached, but Dinarzad urged her to continue. Shahrazad then recounted how the old woman revealed herself to be Queen Lab’s mother. The she-mule was actually Jullanar of the Sea in human form.
paragraphs.zh: 莎赫拉兹正待停口，但迪纳兹催促她继续讲下去。于是，莎赫拉兹 Adapted as follows: 莎赫拉兹犹豫了一下，但迪纳兹催促她继续说。莎赫拉兹接着讲述了那位老妇人其实是拉卜女王的母亲。原来那只母驴竟是海之尤兰娜化的人形。

paragraphs.en: Upon receiving the mule, the old woman removed the bit and sprinkled water on her, transforming Jullanar back into a beautiful young woman. The two women embraced.
paragraphs.zh: 老妇人接过骡子，取下嚼环，在她身上洒了些水，顿时将朱拉娜变回了一个美丽的少女。两位女子相拥而泣。

paragraphs.en: Realizing his mistake, King Badr tried to flee but found no escape.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到自己的错误后，Badr王企图逃跑，却发现已无路可逃。

paragraphs.en: The old woman whistled loudly, summoning a demon as large as a mountain. She mounted its back with her daughter and placed King Badr on its shoulder. The demon flew them to Queen Lab's palace.
paragraphs.zh: 老妇人吹了一声响亮的口哨，召唤出一只比山还大的恶魔。她和女儿骑上了它的背，将国王巴德放在了恶魔的肩上。恶魔带着他们飞向了拉卜王后的宫殿。

paragraphs.en: Queen Lab sat on the throne and looked at King Badr. "You worthless man," she said, "I have achieved my wish. I will turn you into an ugly bird as punishment."
paragraphs.zh: 女王拉布坐在王座上，望着国王巴德，脱口而出：“你这个无用的家伙，我已经如愿以偿。我要把你变成一只难看的鸟作为惩罚。”

paragraphs.en: She sprinkled him with water, causing him to transform into a grotesque bird. She then locked him in a cage, denying him food and water.
paragraphs.zh: 她用清水洒向他，让他变成了一只畸形的鸟。随后，她将他关进笼子里，既不给他食物也不给水喝。

paragraphs.en: One of her servants felt pity for King Badr and secretly provided him with sustenance. The servant informed the old man about this and warned that Queen Lab planned to destroy his nephew. After much thought, the old man decided he must take the city from Queen Lab.
paragraphs.zh: 其中一个仆人对国王巴德心生怜悯，暗中给他提供了食物。他把这件事告诉了那位老人，并警告说女王拉布计划要摧毁他的侄子。经过深思熟虑之后，老人决定必须从女王拉布手中夺回城市。

paragraphs.en: He whistled again, summoning a four-winged demon named Barq.
paragraphs.zh: 他又吹了一声口哨，召唤出一只名为巴克的四翼恶魔。

paragraphs.en: "Take this girl who helped King Badr," the old man instructed Barq, "and bring her to Jullanar of the Sea and her mother Farasha, the most powerful magicians in the world. Tell them that King Badr is Queen Lab's captive."
paragraphs.zh: 老者对巴尔克吩咐道：“把那个帮助过.badr国王的女孩带去见海之女王朱拉纳尔以及她的母亲法拉斯哈，她们是世界上最强大的巫师。告诉她们，badr国王被拉布女王俘虏了。”

paragraphs.en: Jullanar took the girl to her palace roof. After the girl recounted her ordeal, Jullanar thanked and embraced her son Badr upon his return in human form. Sayih and Farasha also rejoiced, hugging and kissing him.
paragraphs.zh: 朱拉纳尔将女孩带到她的宫殿屋顶。听完女孩的遭遇后，朱拉纳尔回头感谢并拥抱了以人形归来的儿子巴德。赛伊赫和法拉莎也喜出望外，紧紧拥抱着他，亲吻着他。

paragraphs.en: Then Jullanar summoned demons and sea troops. They flew to the City of Magicians, where they swiftly killed all inhabitants.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，朱兰娜召唤出恶魔和海军部队。他们飞向 magician 城，迅速将所有居民尽数杀光。

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that Jullanar married the old fava-bean seller, Abdullah, to the girl who brought news of Badr's safe return.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说贾卢娜尔嫁给了卖鹰豆的老阿卜杜拉，而这位新娘正是带来了巴德安全归来的消息的人。

paragraphs.en: King Badr told his mother, "Mother, I must marry Princess Jauhara from King al-Shamandal to unite us all." His mother agreed but suggested they first find suitable candidates among other princesses. Grandmother Farasha and Uncle Sayih promised to search immediately.
paragraphs.zh: 国王巴德对母亲说：“母亲，我必须娶沙马兰德国王的女儿贾乌哈拉公主为妻，这样才能把大家团结起来。”他母亲同意了，但建议他们先在其他公主中寻找合适的对象。法拉斯哈奶奶和塞伊赫叔叔承诺会立即开始搜寻。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, Jullanar sent her waiting-women on demons to scout every province, city, and palace for beautiful girls. When Badr saw his mother's efforts, he said, "Mother, stop this; no one will satisfy me."
paragraphs.zh: 与此同时，朱兰娜派遣她的侍女前往各个省份、城市和宫殿侦察美丽的少女。看到母亲的举动，巴德脱口而出：“妈妈，别再这样做了；没有人能让我满意。”

paragraphs.en: The next night, Shahrazad continued:
paragraphs.zh: 第二天晚上，沙海拉扎德接着说：

paragraphs.en: I heard that King Badr declared Princess Jauhara as the only suitable bride. His mother agreed and summoned King al-Shamandal, who kissed the ground before her. Then she brought in King Badr and proposed his marriage to Jauhara.
paragraphs.zh: 我听说国王巴德尔宣布贾乌哈拉公主是唯一的合适王后。他的母亲表示赞同，并召见了沙马兰达国王，后者在她面前吻了地面。随后，她带进了巴德尔国王，并提议将他许配给贾乌哈拉。

paragraphs.en: Badr welcomed al-Shamandal and requested his daughter's hand. Al-Shamandal readily agreed and sent officers to fetch Princess Jauhara. The officers returned with her shortly.
paragraphs.zh: 巴德热情地迎接了沙马纳德，并请求娶他的女儿。沙马纳德欣然应允，派官员去迎娶公主贾乌哈拉。不久，官员们便带着她回来了。

paragraphs.en: Upon seeing her father, Jullanar approached him, embraced him, and wept. Her father then declared, "O my daughter, I have chosen King Badr for you; he is the best, most handsome, and exalted man of our time." She replied, "Father, I will obey your wishes."
paragraphs.zh: 见到父亲后，朱拉纳走向他，拥抱他，不禁泪流满面。她父亲随后宣布：“我的女儿啊，我已经为你选定了国王巴德尔；他是我们这个时代最优秀、最英俊、最受尊敬的人。”她回答说：“父亲，我愿意遵从您的意愿。”

paragraphs.en: They summoned witnesses to draft the marriage contract, celebrated with drums, freed prisoners, clothed widows and orphans, and bestowed honor on princes. A ten-day wedding feast followed, during which Jullanar was unveiled in seven different robes. King Badr consummated their union, finding her a virgin and rejoicing greatly.
paragraphs.zh: 他们召集证人起草婚约，敲锣打鼓地庆祝，释放了囚犯，为寡妇和孤儿披上新衣，并给王子们以荣誉。随后是一场为期十天的盛大婚礼宴席，在此期间，朱兰娜身着七套不同礼服依次亮相。巴德国王 consummated 他们的婚约，发现她仍是处女，欣喜若狂。

paragraphs.en: He then honored her father with riches and sent him home happily.
paragraphs.zh: 随后他用丰厚的财富荣耀了她的父亲，并让他满心欢喜地返回家中。

paragraphs.en: The couple continued to enjoy life until the end came, breaking all ties and destroying all delights. This concludes their story.
paragraphs.zh: 这对夫妇继续享受着生活，直到最终来临，所有的联系都被切断，所有的快乐也都烟消云散。这就是他们的故事。
